Use case: the organiser opens Demo Finals for tonight at 1280 px or on a phone; the legacy's values are the defaults

g.text: One season at a time; it opens for sign-ups as soon as you create it.

svg.text: At phone width, top and scrolled
Choices stack; the size cards go three to a row; the arenas wrap.
Size is chosen by picture: each card shows its teams, its
players and the shape of its bracket (L2).
Arenas are chips from the game's list; the final may be forced
into a different arena, as the legacy's random pick did (D13).
Times use a picker; the vote threshold a stepper. Nothing is a
'From the team builder' skips sign-ups: the crew builds teams
